keywords.title: Keyword check
keywords.sub: What this posting asks for, and whether your resume shows it.
keywords.fitNone: No fit score for this version of your resume yet.
keywords.fitHonesty: This is not your chance of getting hired.
keywords.honest: Only add a missing keyword if it is true for you.
keywords.fromPosting: Keywords read from the posting text.
keywords.error: The keyword check could not load.
keywords.yearsDetail: Asks for {required}+ years; your dated experience adds up to about {found}.
keywords.yearsNotListed: The posting does not list a number of years.
keywords.yearsNoDates: No dated experience found in your resume.
keywords.eduNotListed: The posting does not list an education level.
keywords.eduNotFound: No degree found in your resume.
keywords.eduMet: Your degree meets the listed level.
keywords.eduBelow: Your degree is below the listed level.
keywords.titlePass: Your resume shows this title or a close one.
keywords.titleWarn: Your resume shows a related title.
keywords.titleFail: Your resume does not show this title. If you have done this work, name it in a heading or the summary.

layout_table.title: Table in your resume
layout_table.why: Company software may not read this. Tables often come out scrambled when hiring software reads a resume.
layout_table.how: Turn the table into plain lines or bullets.

layout_columns.title: Two-column layout
layout_columns.why: Company software may not read this. It can read across both columns and mix lines together.

layout_image.title: Image in your resume
layout_image.why: Company software may not read this. Text inside images, icons or charts cannot be read.
layout_image.how: Remove images and write the information as text.

layout_symbols.title: Symbols or emoji ({symbol})
layout_symbols.why: Company software may not read this. Emoji and decorative symbols can turn into odd characters.
layout_symbols.how: Replace symbols with plain words, for example "Email:" instead of an icon.

contact_name_missing.title: No name at the top
contact_name_missing.why: Without a name at the top, nobody knows whose resume this is.
contact_name_missing.how: Put your full name on the first line.

contact_email_missing.title: No email address
contact_email_missing.why: Employers need a way to reply to you.
contact_email_missing.how: Add an email address you check every day.

contact_phone_missing.title: No phone number
contact_phone_missing.why: Many employers call to set up the first conversation.

section_experience_missing.title: No experience section
section_experience_missing.why: Experience is the first thing most readers look for.
section_experience_missing.how: Add an Experience section with your jobs, internships or substantial projects.

section_education_missing.title: No education section
section_education_missing.why: Many postings list an education requirement, and readers check for it.
section_education_missing.how: Add an Education section with school, degree and dates.

section_skills_missing.title: No skills section
section_skills_missing.why: A skills list is where readers and software look for the tools a job asks for.
section_skills_missing.how: Add a Skills section with the tools and methods you actually use.

summary_missing.title: No summary
summary_missing.why: Two sentences at the top tell the reader what you do before they read the details.
summary_missing.how: Add a short summary: your role, your strongest area, and what you want next.

summary_too_short.title: Very short summary
summary_too_short.why: A very short summary does not say what makes you a fit.
summary_too_short.how: Write two or three sentences about your role, your strongest area and a result.

summary_too_long.title: Long summary
summary_too_long.why: Readers skim the top of a resume; a long summary gets skipped.
summary_too_long.how: Cut it to two or three sentences.

weak_verb.title: Weak opener: "{opener}"
weak_verb.why: Openers like "responsible for" describe a duty, not what you did.
weak_verb.how: Start with what you did: built, led, cut, shipped.

no_numbers.title: Few results with numbers ({withNumbers} of {total} bullets)
no_numbers.why: Few of your bullets show a result someone could measure.
no_numbers.how: Add a real number where you have one: people, time, money, volume or percent. Do not guess.

bullet_too_long.title: Long bullet
bullet_too_long.why: Long bullets are hard to skim.
bullet_too_long.how: Keep each bullet to one or two lines: what you did and the result.

buzzwords.title: Common phrases: {terms}
buzzwords.why: Phrases every resume uses do not tell the reader anything about you.
buzzwords.how: Replace them with a specific example of the quality you mean.

skills_too_few.title: Short skills list ({count} listed)
skills_too_few.why: A short skills list can hide tools a job asks for.
skills_too_few.how: List the tools, languages and methods you use, at least {min}.

length_too_long.title: Longer than two pages
length_too_long.why: This resume is likely longer than two pages, and readers rarely get that far.
length_too_long.how: Keep it to one or two pages: cut older or less relevant bullets.

spelling.title: Possible spelling mistake: "{word}"
spelling.why: Spelling mistakes are noticed quickly and look careless.

summary_vague.title: General summary
summary_vague.why: The summary is general and could describe many people.
summary_vague.how: Name your role, your strongest area and one real result.

cn_self_evaluation_missing.title: No self-evaluation (自我评价)
cn_self_evaluation_missing.why: Many Chinese employers expect a short self-evaluation.
cn_self_evaluation_missing.how: Add two or three sentences with concrete strengths, not slogans.

cn_internship_missing.title: No internship (实习)
cn_internship_missing.why: For students and new graduates, internships are the experience employers look for first.
cn_internship_missing.how: Add an internship section, or list substantial projects or campus work if you have no internship.

cn_english_cert_missing.title: No English certificate listed
cn_english_cert_missing.why: Many employers check English level (CET-4/6, IELTS, TOEFL).
cn_english_cert_missing.how: If you have an English certificate or score, list it under skills and certificates.

cn_personal_details_optional.title: Optional personal details ({label})
cn_personal_details_optional.why: Details like 籍贯, 政治面貌 or birth date are optional on most resumes.
cn_personal_details_optional.how: Keep them only if the employer asks for them.

cn_photo_optional.title: Photo (optional)
cn_photo_optional.why: A photo is optional. Some employers ask for one; many do not.
cn_photo_optional.how: Keep a recent, professional photo only if the employer asks for one.

focus.gone: The issue you opened is not in the latest check. It may already be fixed.
